decisions.statement: Use REST/JSON and OpenAPI, frozen shared HTTP errors and command headers. Upstream REST controllers and separate service paths inform responsibilities, not endpoint/schema compatibility. Existing Jeeves durable sessions own principal identity; no new credential implementation or copied Rails/GraphQL runtime.

Trusted application/organization/group scope is established server-side. Customers see own tickets by default; organization sharing requires explicit policy. Agents need current group/action membership. Recheck on detail/list/commands/replay/search/counts/bytes/audit/notification/export; no implicit report bypass or client role authority.

Require a nonempty initial public article and atomic ticket/article/audit/deadline/command-receipt/durable-intent writes in one SQL transaction. Canonical input replay is authenticated and scope-bound; same key/different input conflicts. ExpectedVersion and locked current access/state choose one concurrent winner; external I/O stays outside SQL.

Author/time and public/internal classification are server-controlled. Reject customer privileged fields rather than silently removing them. Internal note text and every byte/search/count/export/notification projection are agent-only under current ticket access; visibility never follows ticket ownership alone.

Freeze new/open/pending/resolved/closed with explicit resolved->open, no closed->open in core. Invalid/stale transitions leave article/deadline/audit unchanged. Reads have no assignment side effect. Assignment to inactive/revoked/foreign agent is rejected, not silently reset to an unassigned sentinel.

Reduced core: start at ticket creation; count actual elapsed UTC time whose America/Chicago wall time lies in configured working intervals. Stop only at an authorized customer-visible agent reply. Internal notes and pending state do not stop/pause it. Closing cancels unmet without satisfying it; reopening creates no new first-response clock. Other response/solution/pause policies remain Z15.

Snapshot immutable calendar and SLA versions on each deadline. Baseline Monday-Friday 09:00-17:00 America/Chicago with explicit holiday dates and no remote feed. Repeated fall-back time counts twice, missing spring time contributes nothing. Editing/deleting labels/configuration never rewrites old deadlines. P61d fixes independent exact UTC expectations; P87 chooses maintained timezone library.

Persist due time, ticket/deadline/policy version, cancellation/satisfaction and logical escalation identity. Workers claim bounded overdue batches with finite fenced leases; transaction rechecks current state/version before one escalation+audit+intent. Restart catches up visibly; downtime is lateness, never an SLA success. Enqueue locks/daily suppression are not proof of this guarantee.

Finite versioned predicates/actions with explicit priority/tie order, match mode and action budget. Persist deduplication/audit; routing cannot grant group access, impersonate former actors or form unbounded cascades. Upstream name ordering/recursive trigger settings are not adopted.

Stage/inspect bounded MIME and <=10 MiB bytes, then authorize same-scope ticket/article association. Recheck article visibility and current ticket policy for proxied bytes and raw exports. Incomplete/quarantined bytes are unavailable; SQL/store failures leave bounded recoverable orphans, not unsafe download links.

Use bounded PostgreSQL projections and stable keyset cursors with ID tie-break, limit default 25/max 100. Authoritative ticket and article policy filters apply before pages/snippets/counts/audit; stale index membership cannot leak after revocation. Upstream SQL/Elasticsearch call sites do not prove whole-path internal-note redaction.

Persist inbox/delivery intent and per-event/recipient receipts atomically, expand recipients in bounded batches, recheck current membership/preferences/field visibility before materialization/read/send. External mail can be ambiguous; record unknown/reconcile instead of claiming exactly-once delivery. Retries do not reopen closed tickets implicitly.

rows.adaptation: Authentication calls and customer field removal inform boundaries, not a complete session/restart audit. Reuse Jeeves sessions; reject forged role/scope/privileged fields instead of silently stripping them.

Group action grants/customer ownership/shared organizations inspire policy. Separate trusted application scope from group membership; report privilege cannot bypass scoped access, and assignment targets must remain eligible.

Source transaction creates ticket and optional article; it is not a canonical command receipt. Core requires initial public article, rollback before article insert and one ticket/article after committed response-loss replay.

Internal policy gate and article-list filtering are inspected; attachment/search/mail serializers are not exhaustively audited. Enforce immutable author/time and internal redaction independently at every frozen disclosure observation.

Source locks updates and resets an ineligible owner to sentinel for nonclosed tickets. Core rejects invalid assignment and rechecks current membership plus expectedVersion inside the transaction, yielding one version-9 winner from version 8.

Upstream agents may reopen closed tickets and deadlines recalculate after commit. Freeze the smaller explicit graph and atomic article/deadline/audit outcomes; resolved reopening creates no new first-response clock.

Use only reduced first-response clock; no upstream state breaks, mutable-calendar rebuild or communication-channel requirement. Snapshot versions; independently fix weekend/holiday/DST exact UTC expectations rather than running upstream evaluator.

Batched due scan, forced rebuild and job locks are reference recovery paths, not per-deadline fencing or one logical escalation proof. Persist receipts/version rechecks/cancellation and visible bounded catch-up after worker restart.
Upstream name order, recursive loop maximum and trigger-ID list show bounds. Core defines explicit priority/match/action budgets and durable rule identity; matching never grants access.

Byte route checks ticket and article/file association; raw-message route checks article policy. Uninspected download helpers/clone paths are not full visibility proof. Core authorizes article and bytes plus staged metadata/store recovery.

Search adds group/customer/shared-organization constraints and index payload includes article/attachment data. No full internal-search/snippet/rebuild audit. Core uses authoritative redaction before keyset pages/counts/audit, including after revocation.

Recipient preferences and daily history suppression are not durable per-event receipts. External send precedes saved success; core rechecks current visibility and persists deduplicated intent with explicit ambiguous outcomes, without implicit reopen.

Outgoing message/reference context only; inbound authentication/MIME/thread parser was not inspected. Implement a bounded verified-source hook, never accept mail identity or Message-ID as authority/exactly-once proof.
Follow-up and merged-ticket attachment branches provide context, not a merge/split algorithm audit. Preserve identity/history/internal visibility with explicit ambiguity and recovery decisions.

Upstream additional clocks/state breaks/forced recalculation are inspected context. They are excluded from Z07 core and require a typed versioned hook with controlled recalculation and frozen history.
Jeeves-specific integration contract; no upstream customer connector inspected or availability inferred. Source authority/revision and reconciliation remain explicit project work.
Jeeves-specific publication/access contract; no upstream knowledge-base implementation inspected or availability inferred. Ticket article access is not knowledge-base publication semantics.
Trigger loop context is not a custom-schema/workflow engine audit. Keep typed bounded extensions, finite actions and no executable strings, with explicit migration and retry policy.

Ticket history/article policy context only; no upstream export/erasure implementation inspected. Define customer-safe projection, retention/holds/audit and resumable progress without internal-note disclosure.

Business-minute measurement and report scope exception provide context, not operational metric definitions or a report-engine audit. Core hook keeps authorized bounded aggregates, explicit reopened counting and independent expected values.
